scripts.build: pnpm --filter @restocafe/types build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter ops-web build && pnpm --filter landing build
scripts.verify:repo: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run verify:permissions
scripts.verify:integration: pnpm run db:provider:check && pnpm run db:generate && pnpm run db:connect:check && pnpm run redis:connect:check && pnpm run db:migrate:deploy && pnpm run db:seed && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.verify:e2e:smoke: pnpm run db:provider:check && pnpm run db:generate && pnpm run db:connect:check && pnpm run redis:connect:check && pnpm run db:migrate:deploy && pnpm run db:seed && pnpm run build && node scripts/verify-e2e-smoke.mjs
scripts.verify:everything: pnpm run verify:repo && pnpm run verify:integration && pnpm run verify:e2e:smoke
scripts.verify:mysql:local: pnpm run db:provider:check:mysql && pnpm run db:create:mysql && pnpm run db:generate:mysql && pnpm run db:connect:check:mysql && pnpm run db:migrate:deploy:mysql && pnpm run db:seed:mysql && node scripts/run-with-provider.mjs mysql -- pnpm --filter api run build
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio
scripts.dev:setup: pnpm run infra:up && pnpm run infra:wait && pnpm run db:generate && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.dev:setup:mysql: pnpm run db:provider:check:mysql && pnpm run db:create:mysql && pnpm run db:generate:mysql && pnpm run db:connect:check:mysql && pnpm run db:migrate:deploy:mysql && pnpm run db:seed:mysql
scripts.dev:api:mysql: node scripts/run-with-provider.mjs mysql -- pnpm --filter api run start:dev
scripts.test:regression: pnpm --filter api run test && pnpm --filter ops-web run test && pnpm --filter ops-web run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.db:generate:mysql: node scripts/run-with-provider.mjs mysql -- pnpm --filter api run prisma:generate
scripts.db:migrate:deploy:mysql: node scripts/run-with-provider.mjs mysql -- pnpm --filter api run prisma:migrate:deploy
scripts.db:seed:mysql: node scripts/run-with-provider.mjs mysql -- pnpm --filter api run prisma:seed
